references.text: The instruction to make two silver trumpets to be used for assembling the congregation and for breaking camp.
Continuation of the instruction on trumpet blasts to signal departure, this time for the camps on the south side.
Description of the camps positioned toward the east (קֵדְמָה), led by the tribe of Judah, which were to break camp first.
The trumpets used to sound an alarm (תְּרוּעָה) in war against the Midianites.
The use of trumpets and shouting (תְּרוּעָה) at the conquest of Jericho.
The trumpet of jubilee (תְּרוּעָה) that was to sound throughout the land.
Gideon's use of trumpets as a signal for battle.
A call to blow the horn at the new moon, referring to trumpet blowing on holy occasions.
